title: RadLab reading review
sort_basis: Descending absolute difference between the largest and smallest rate in a group; not scientific severity

summary.calculation: Linear interpolation between the nearest distinct timestamp groups with unambiguous rates
summary.numeric_export: Computed values are decimal strings rounded to 50 significant digits; comparisons use exact fractions
summary.interpretation: Descriptive local-trend comparison only; source order is not acquisition order or evidence of physical correctness
